information:
## The competition is cancelled due to weather. All competitors have been fully refunded. Please check your emails for more information.

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association (MCA)](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcDAwIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9d340df17a1aec4ba42677c10d4db2f31757ffba/image.png)

We have local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. Feel free to join the [Minnesota Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480), which supports the Dakotas, and follow the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.facebook.com/midwestcubing) for information and announcements on upcoming competitions.
